about:
Automotive Specialty Equipment, Inc. was founded in 1988 by Dan and Janet Duvall in Midvale, Utah. The couple started the business from their home, and a dedicated warehouse facility was added in 1996 to support growing customer demand. The company serves the Intermountain region, including Utah, Idaho, Nevada, and Wyoming.

The firm operates as a distributor of name-brand automotive repair and service equipment. Its product range includes vehicle lifts (two-post, four-post, inground, and home storage models), tire changers, wheel balancers, A/C recovery and recycling machines, air compressors, and a variety of hand and power tools. The company also provides ALI-certified hoist inspections, financing options, installation services, warranty support, and shipping.

Customers are primarily independent automotive service shops, dealership service departments, and home-garage enthusiasts across the Intermountain West. The company represents brands such as Robinair, Challenger, Mondolfo Ferro, ADG, and Haweka.

The business was built on the goal of helping service shops increase revenue by supplying reliable, brand-name equipment backed by technical expertise. The team’s combined automotive industry experience spans more than 48 years.
